newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks open slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks open slightly higher.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened slightly higher on Wednesday, with firm sentiment carried over from the previous day.
But brokers said the key market index is unlikely to extend its recent gains by very much due to profit-taking pressure.
After nine minutes of trade, the 225-share Nikkei average was up 14.40 points or 0.07 percent at 20,577.56. On Tuesday, the Nikkei index finished its highest close since December 11.
Its June futures traded 10 points higher at 20,570.
"I don't expect the Nikkei 225 to post a sharp rally," said a broker at a second-tier Japanese securities house.
